title: The Sunless Citadel
description: A search for missing adventurers leads into a buried fortress where kobold and goblin factions compete for control, and an ancient druid tends the sinister Gulthias Tree.
artCredit: Adventure cover and official module maps © Wizards of the Coast / TSR. Reference artwork via D&D Beyond.

title: The Forge of Fury
description: An old map points to Khundrukar, the ruined stronghold of the dwarf smith Durgeddin the Black. Its monster-held depths conceal the legendary blades Durgeddin forged.
artCredit: Adventure cover and official module maps © Wizards of the Coast / TSR. Reference artwork via D&D Beyond.

title: The Speaker in Dreams
description: During Brindinford’s annual street fair, a sudden attack reveals a hidden campaign to seize control of the town. The heroes must uncover the force behind the unrest before the city falls.
artCredit: Original adventure cover © Wizards of the Coast / TSR. Reference image via Wikipedia.

title: The Standing Stone
description: In the isolated village of Ossington, a ghostly rider, hostile elves, and ancient standing stones point to a mystery built on misdirection and a threat to the villagers.
artCredit: Original adventure cover © Wizards of the Coast / TSR. Reference image via Wikipedia.

title: Heart of Nightfang Spire
description: Rumors of a dragon’s hoard draw the party to Nightfang Spire, an ancient temple turned tomb. There, vampire Gulthias prepares the undead cult of Ashardalon for the dragon’s return.
artCredit: Original adventure cover © Wizards of the Coast / TSR. Reference image via Wikipedia.

title: Deep Horizon
description: Earthquakes lead into the desmodu realm, threatened by beholders, salamanders and a trade in captives. The Brotherhood’s diversion of the lava saves a village, with consequences that unfold across the company’s missing fifty years.
artCredit: Original adventure cover © Wizards of the Coast / TSR. Reference image via Wikipedia.

title: Lord of the Iron Fortress
description: On the plane of Acheron, Imperagon is reforging the Blade of Fiery Might with the imprisoned spirits of legendary smiths. The heroes must confront the ruler of the Iron Fortress before he can turn the weapon toward conquest.
artCredit: Original adventure cover © Wizards of the Coast / TSR. Reference image via Wikipedia.

title: Those Who Writhe Below
tagline: A familiar presence beneath the surface
period: After Lord of the Iron Fortress
description: An underwater aboleth lair, its traps, and its fanatical servants form the heart of this subterranean side trek. The creature later returns in the campaign as Brother Xanthar.
artCredit: Adventure artwork © its creators. Reference image from the DMDave listing on Roll20.

title: White Plume Mountain
period: Their earlier selves, before Icewind Dale
description: Flashed back to their eighth-level selves in Brindinford, the company follows Keraptis’s challenge beneath White Plume Mountain. Its eventual return lands fifty years beyond its own time, with Brindinford destroyed by volcanic catastrophe.
artCredit: Original adventure cover © Wizards of the Coast / TSR. Reference image via Wikipedia.

title: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden
description: An endless winter and the loss of magic draw the company north. Pengu, released when Shrop snuffed a candle in the Nightmare Grotto, threatens the Dale while Keraptis’s weapons and the road back to Bastion remain entangled with the struggle.
artCredit: Original adventure cover © Wizards of the Coast / TSR. Reference image via Wikipedia.

title: Fungus Grotto
period: The journey home from Icewind Dale
description: Team Gravy and a deceived, dispossessed Team Biscuit meet beneath Brindinford to fight giant ants. At the Reality Wrinkle, a hell trap meant for Biscuit catches Gravy instead, while Biscuit’s road continues to Windglum and Bastion.
artCredit: Decorative chapter illustration; not a published module cover.

title: Bastion of Broken Souls
description: Returning to the unfinished struggle with Ashardalon, the company follows the Wrinkle to Windglum, seeks the Soul Totem in Desayeus’s prison, and fights into the Bastion where unborn souls feed a failing dragon heart.
artCredit: Original adventure cover © Wizards of the Coast / TSR. Reference image via Wikipedia.

title: Between Adventures
description: A collection of campaign images and films from across the journey.
artCredit: Still from the selected party farewell film.
